control_flow: followInTheDark: if LLIGHT is below 70 % (dim, in a tunnel): if the line tracker reads below 90 %, curve left (10/30); else if it reads above 90 %, curve right (30/10); else call avoidWalls. Otherwise (bright): call avoidWalls.
avoidWalls: if LLIGHT is below 70 %: if an obstacle is on the left, turn right 20°; else if one is on the right, turn left 20°; else call driveInTheDark. Otherwise: call driveInTheDark.
driveInTheDark: if LLIGHT is below 70 %: drive forward at 30 % without end. Otherwise: call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if an obstacle is ahead: stop. Otherwise: call followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black: curve left (10/40). Otherwise: curve right (40/10).

likely_intent.description: Follow the black line, and keep following it when it runs into a dark tunnel.
